stories.title: Germany moves to allow 180-day Bitcoin freezes without private key access
stories.summary: German authorities have advanced a measure that lets them freeze Bitcoin holdings for up to 180 days. The power applies even when officials do not hold the private keys. CryptoSlate reports the move without detailing the exact law or which agency enforces it.
stories.whyItMatters: The measure gives regulators a new way to restrain crypto assets tied to investigations. Other regulators may copy this model.
whatToWatch: Confirmation of the legal basis and the agency that holds this power
How exchanges and custodians are told to comply
Whether other EU states adopt similar rules
questions: What statute or legal authority grants the freeze power?
How would a freeze work against a self-custodied wallet?

sources.title: Germany moves to freeze Bitcoin for up to 180 days, even without access to private keys

stories.title: Bitcoin buyers accumulate 66,000 BTC near $62,000 support
stories.summary: Buyers have accumulated about 66,000 BTC in a zone near $62,000. CryptoSlate calls this a critical support level for the current market. A separate CryptoSlate report says some Bitcoin miners now profit without mining BTC directly, though it adds the edge may not last.
stories.whyItMatters: Whether this price floor holds matters for near-term direction, and the miner strategy shift could affect network security incentives.
whatToWatch: Whether the $62,000 zone holds on the next price move
Follow-up on how long the miners' alternative profit method lasts
questions: Is the 66,000 BTC accumulation from a few large holders or broad buying?
What is driving the shift in miner profit strategy?

sources.title: Bitcoin buyers pile 66,000 BTC into critical $62,000 support zone
Bitcoin miners found a way to profit without mining BTC, but the advantage may not last

stories.title: Backpack's US approval could challenge offshore exchanges in crypto futures
stories.summary: Crypto exchange Backpack has won US approval that CryptoSlate says could threaten offshore platforms' grip on crypto futures trading. Offshore venues have long carried most of that volume with less oversight. The source does not specify the exact license type or its scope.
stories.whyItMatters: A regulated US path for crypto futures could pull volume and institutional interest away from less-supervised offshore exchanges.
whatToWatch: Which regulator granted the approval, and its exact scope
Whether trading volume shifts measurably toward Backpack
questions: What specific license or registration did Backpack receive?

stories.title: OpenAI brings in an outside safety evaluator: what will it tell the public?
stories.summary: OpenAI has engaged an outside evaluator to assess its safety practices. CryptoSlate asks how much of the evaluator's findings the company will actually disclose. The source does not name the evaluator or detail its mandate.
stories.whyItMatters: AI safety oversight shapes the trust and regulatory climate across the tech sector that crypto firms compete in for capital and talent.
whatToWatch: Whether OpenAI publishes the evaluator's full findings
Disclosure of the evaluator's identity and mandate
questions: Who is the outside evaluator, and what is their mandate?
Will results be published in full or only summarized?

stories.title: Coinbase's AI system blocked a $4.7 million scam, but a simple lie got past it
stories.summary: Coinbase says its AI fraud detection stopped a scam attempt worth $4.7 million. CryptoSlate reports the same system was still fooled by a simple lie, which exposed a gap in its checks. The source gives no detail on the exact exploit or whether a fix is in place.
stories.whyItMatters: The case shows both the value and the current limits of AI fraud defenses at an exchange that holds customer funds.
whatToWatch: Whether Coinbase patches the weakness that was exposed
Any further disclosure on how the lie bypassed detection
questions: What was the specific lie that exposed the weakness?
How many similar attempts may have succeeded before this was caught?

sources.title: Coinbase AI blocks $4.7 million scam, but a simple lie exposes its weakness

stories.title: Bitcoin options show rising downside premiums ahead of Fed minutes
stories.summary: Options traders are paying higher premiums for downside protection on Bitcoin. CryptoSlate links the shift to the upcoming release of Federal Reserve meeting minutes. The source does not give the size of the premium move or specific expiry dates.
stories.whyItMatters: Rising hedging costs ahead of a Fed event signal traders see real downside risk, not just routine volatility.
whatToWatch: The Fed minutes release and the market's reaction
Whether downside premiums ease or keep rising beforehand
questions: How large is the premium skew compared to recent history?
Which strikes and expiries carry the heaviest positioning?

stories.title: Bitcoin faces pressure as US inflation hits a 38-year high
stories.summary: US consumer prices rose at their fastest pace in 38 years. CryptoSlate frames this as a new headwind for Bitcoin, since faster inflation raises the odds of a tougher Fed stance. The source does not name the specific inflation index or figure.
stories.whyItMatters: Inflation surprises feed directly into Fed policy expectations, a major driver of risk appetite for Bitcoin and other crypto assets.
whatToWatch: The Fed's policy response to the new inflation data
Bitcoin's price reaction over the following sessions
questions: Which inflation measure, CPI or PCE, is being referenced?
How are Fed officials characterizing the reading so far?

stories.title: America's $1 trillion AI data center boom hits its first slowdown in over a year
stories.summary: The US AI data center buildout, valued at roughly $1 trillion, has posted its first slowdown in more than a year, CryptoSlate reports. The source does not say whether new project starts, capital spending, or construction pace slowed. It marks a shift after a long stretch of rapid growth.
stories.whyItMatters: Data center and power demand compete with crypto mining for the same infrastructure, so a slowdown here could ease pressure on power and hardware costs.
whatToWatch: Whether the slowdown continues into coming quarters
Any knock-on effect on power prices or data center capacity
questions: What specifically slowed: new projects, spending, or construction?
Is this a pause or the start of a longer trend?

stories.title: Anthropic's Claude completes a 16-hour research task in under 3 hours
stories.summary: Anthropic's Claude model finished a research task that normally takes a person about 16 hours in under 3 hours, CryptoSlate reports. The source does not describe the task or how the comparison was measured. It is presented as a marker of AI productivity gains, not a crypto-specific event.
stories.whyItMatters: Faster AI research tools are increasingly used for market analysis and due diligence, including by crypto research teams.
whatToWatch: Independent checks on the task comparison and methodology
Wider adoption of similar AI tools in financial and crypto research
questions: What was the specific task, and how was the 16-hour baseline set?
Does the speedup hold across different kinds of research work?
